name: mastery-learning
description: A local-first Codex tutor that diagnoses, teaches, tests, and tracks durable mastery.

interface.shortDescription: Learn anything through evidence, practice, and review.
interface.longDescription: Turns Codex into the learner's primary interface: it diagnoses prerequisites, creates an auditable curriculum, teaches interactively, coaches code and experiments, evaluates transfer, and keeps transparent local learning memory.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn a vague learning goal into a tested, personalized plan.
Continue my learning session from local progress and due reviews.
Teach this concept interactively and verify that I can transfer it.
